# International Literacy Association

> > Global literacy advocacy organization connecting research and practice to advance equitable literacy education as a fundamental human right.

The International Literacy Association (ILA), formerly the International Reading Association, serves a network of 300,000+ educators across 75 countries. The organization publishes Literacy Today Magazine and Literacy Now Blog, maintains the Literacy Learning Library, and advocates for initiatives like Children's Rights to Read.

## Key Topics

- International Literacy Association (ILA)
- Literacy advocacy and education
- Children's Rights to Read
- Literacy Learning Library
- Literacy Today Magazine
- Literacy Now Blog
- Global educator community
- Research-to-practice connection
- Equitable literacy access
- Board of Directors governance
- Educator professional development
- Literacy as human right
- International Reading Association (legacy)
- Membership and community engagement
